change: Background Spark model observation every 30 seconds instead of 5; existing 5-second agent report/contact loop remains unchanged.
behavior: First broker observation is immediate; record attempt before launching to throttle failures and prevent overlap.
Refresh at the existing 5-second cadence during active jobs and model startup/shutdown. Reading logs keeps the background model interval.
Retain actual snapshot timestamps; separate cached observation age from agent connectivity.
Keep fresh exact native checks before effects; cached background samples are never effect authority.
rollout: Consistent private controller database backup; controller/UI first, then both Spark monitor binaries with exact mode/owner-preserving atomic replacement and private state/spool/policy backups. No model service restart.
limits: Idle cadence can be 30-35 seconds because scheduling uses the existing 5-second loop. Only active operations and model transitions use faster observations; log viewing does not.
Private credentials, database backups, deployment state and raw logs are excluded from publication.
